title: superlinked is deprecated for new projects
summary: Superlinked marks its legacy Python framework deprecated for new projects and directs new development to SIE and sie-sdk.

constraints: SIE is not a drop-in replacement; preserve schemas, indexing, storage, vector search, query weighting, model behavior, and deployment requirements explicitly.

steps.title: Redesign on SIE where appropriate
steps.instructions: Map legacy framework responsibilities to SIE Server and sie-sdk, redesign incompatible application layers, migrate data and queries, then remove superlinked only after parity is proven.

verification.purpose: Run indexing, retrieval, ranking, storage, deployment, and project tests when defined.
